descricao: The castle's classroom: classes, lessons, flashcards, championship and activities, for the whole school.
entrar.erro.bloqueado: Too many attempts. Wait {minutos} minutes and try again.
entrar.erro.vazio: Fill in your e-mail and password.
primeiro.explicacao: This site has no accounts yet. Create the administration account. The installation code is the one you wrote in the server secrets file.
primeiro.erro.repetir: The two passwords are not the same.
primeiro.erro.sem_codigo: The server doesn't have an installation code yet. Add the codigo_instalacao line to the secrets file.
primeiro.erro.ja_instalado: This site already has an administration account. Sign in with it.
primeiro.erro.senha_curta: The password needs at least 8 characters.
conta.senha_atual_dica: To change your e-mail, confirm with your password.
conta.senha_trocada: Password changed. Use the new one next time you sign in.
conta.erro.email_em_uso: That e-mail already belongs to another account.
conta.erro.senha_curta: The new password needs at least 8 characters.
conta.erro.repetir: The two new passwords are not the same.
conta.erro.proibido: Only the school administration can do this.
textos.explicacao: Here you change how the screens speak to your school. The change applies only to {escola} and shows up right away for everyone in it. Leave it blank to go back to the default text.
textos.idioma: You are editing the texts in {idioma}. To edit another language, change the language at the top of the page.
esqueci.explicacao: Type your account's e-mail. We'll send you a link to create a new password.
esqueci.enviado: Done. If this e-mail has an account, the link arrives in a few minutes (check your spam folder too). It works for 60 minutes.
esqueci.erro.email: That e-mail doesn't look right. Check it and try again.
esqueci.erro.email_desligado: Sending e-mails hasn't been turned on for this site yet. Ask your coordination to change your password.
redefinir.explicacao: Choose the new password (at least 8 letters, numbers or symbols). After saving, you're signed in.
redefinir.erro.senha_curta: The password needs at least 8 characters.
redefinir.erro.codigo_invalido: This link was already used or is older than 60 minutes. Ask for another one.
entrar.criar: No account yet? Create an Ekfrase account
criar.explicacao: With an Ekfrase account you can accept your school's invitation or ask to register a new school. The same account works in every Ekfrase app.
escolas.nenhuma.titulo: You are not in any school yet
escolas.nenhuma.texto: To join a school, open the invitation it sent to your email. If your school does not use Vernákula yet, ask to register it below.
escolas.pedidos.explicacao: Whoever asks becomes the school's administration once the Ekfrase team approves.
escolas.pedidos.aberto: Request of {data}: waiting for the Ekfrase team
escolas.pedir.explicacao: The Ekfrase team checks the request and answers by email. Once approved, you become the school's administration and general coordination and add the courses, classes, students and teachers.
escolas.pedir.mensagem: What you will use Vernákula for
escolas.pedir.mensagem_dica: For example: how many classes, which courses, whether it is a public school, a language course or a project.
escolas.pedir.enviado: Request sent. You will get the answer by email and can also follow it in My schools.
escolas.erro.email: This email does not look right.
escolas.erro.dados: Something is wrong with the data. Check it and try again.
escolas.erro.pedido_aberto: You already have a request waiting for an answer.
escolas.erro.ja_convidado: This person already has an open invitation (see Pending).
escolas.erro.nao_vazio: Only empty items can be deleted: remove the classes or people first.
escolas.erro.ultimo_admin: The school needs at least one person in the administration.
escolas.erro.recente: The invitation was just sent. Wait two minutes to send it again.
escolas.erro.sem_papel: This person does not have that role in the school.
escolas.erro.email_desligado: Email sending is turned off on the server. Tell the Ekfrase team.
escolas.erro.codigo_invalido: This invitation is no longer valid.
escolas.erro.proibido: You are not allowed to do that.
escolas.erro.nao_achado: Not found. It may have been deleted.
escolas.erro.turma: This class does not belong to this school.
escolas.erro.fora: This person is no longer in the school.
convite.entre: To accept, sign in with your Ekfrase account ({email}).
convite.crie: To accept, create your Ekfrase account with the email {email}. It is free, and the same account works in every Ekfrase app.
convite.outra_conta: You are signed in as {sua}, and the invitation was sent to {email}. If you accept, it goes to this account.
convite.invalido.titulo: This invitation is no longer valid
convite.invalido.texto: It was already used, cancelled or has expired. Ask your school to send another one.
convite.recusado.texto: Done: you did not join the school. If you change your mind, ask the school for a new invitation.
admin.cursos.nenhum: There are no courses yet. Start by creating one (English, Spanish…) and, inside it, the classes.
admin.cursos.nenhum_ver: There are no courses yet. The coordination creates courses and classes.
admin.turmas.da_escola: Enrol someone already in the school
admin.cadastro.dica: The person gets an invitation by email and stays pending until accepting, with an existing Ekfrase account or a new one.
admin.cadastro.matriculado: {email} is already in the school: added to the class right away.
admin.pendentes.explicacao: People who were added but have not opened the invitation yet. The invitation is valid for 14 days; sending it again makes a new link and restarts the 14 days.
admin.pendentes.vencido: Sent on {enviado}: expired on {ate}. Send it again.
admin.pendentes.cancelar_confirma: Cancel the registration of {nome}? The invitation link will stop working.
admin.permissoes.explicacao: What each person can do in the school. Only the administration sees and changes this list. The coordination takes care of courses, classes and registrations; the administration, of permissions.
admin.permissoes.sai: With no role, the person leaves the school and its classes.
admin.permissoes.sai_confirma: Remove {nome} from the school and its classes?
